message.content:
Structured wide-leg trousers, cropped just above the ankle bone, #2d241f charcoal brown, heavy wool gabardine.
Tailored blazer, single-breasted with a slightly dropped waistline to elongate the silhouette, #1a1613 deep espresso black, smooth matte crepe.
Cotton-poplin button-up shirt peeking from under the blazer, crisp white with a subtle micro-check pattern, sharp collar.
Leather loafers, pointed toe with a 7cm hidden stiletto heel, #9f8b80 taupe brown, calfskin leather.
Minimalist gold-toned pendant necklace on an 80cm chain, brushed gold vermeil.

This outfit leverages dark monochromatic tones in the bottom half and sharp tailoring to visually stretch the leg line, addressing her specific wish to appear taller. The cropped trouser length combined with the elongated heel creates an uninterrupted vertical flow from hip to toe, maximizing perceived height without altering actual proportions. A structured blazer defines the waist while adding architectural volume that commands authority for the office setting, ensuring she feels both elevated and professional.
